scope: Published Pi and pi-acp binaries with a deterministic loopback model; not Driver or Mosoo E2E

checks.name: session/new without provider request
checks.evidence: Session created; two local models advertised; zero model HTTP requests

checks.name: explicit model selection
checks.evidence: session/set_config_option selects fixture/beta; outgoing request model is beta

checks.name: real Pi write tool, text/thinking stream and end_turn
checks.evidence: Pi wrote expected artifact bytes; ACP tool_call and completed tool_call_update, agent_message_chunk and agent_thought_chunk observed

checks.name: ordinary write approval enforcement
checks.evidence: Actual file write occurred with zero ACP permission requests

checks.name: HTTP MCP forwarding
checks.evidence: HTTP/SSE capability flags false; supplied HTTP endpoint received zero requests

checks.name: structured usage forwarding
checks.evidence: Local model sent usage counts; no ACP usage_update or prompt result usage

checks.name: persistence paths
checks.evidence: Pi session JSONL under PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/sessions; adapter mapping under child HOME/.pi/pi-acp/session-map.json

checks.name: adapter EOF child cleanup after completed prompt
checks.evidence: Adapter exited 0 and its isolated process group no longer existed

checks.name: session/load after process restart
checks.evidence: New adapter process loaded prior session ID and selected model

checks.name: restored history, instruction and Skill availability
checks.evidence: Continuation request contains prior tool output, AGENTS instruction sentinel and global Skill description; no model-obedience claim

checks.name: untrusted project Skill availability
checks.evidence: Untrusted project .pi/skills description absent; project trust was not changed

checks.name: length finish reason
checks.evidence: Provider finish_reason length became ACP end_turn instead of max_tokens

checks.name: provider error outcome
checks.evidence: Provider HTTP 400 became ACP end_turn instead of a request error

checks.name: in-flight cancellation
checks.evidence: session/cancel interrupted an open stream and prompt returned cancelled

checks.name: adapter EOF child cleanup after cancellation
checks.evidence: Adapter exited 0 and its isolated process group no longer existed

notVerified: Driver ACP backend and its different SDK version against the real pair
Mosoo expiring model-bound proxy grants or live external providers
Container image build or cold workspace restoration
Ordinary tool permission denial and sandbox policy enforcement
MCP extension bridge, STDIO or SSE MCP behavior
Model obedience to instructions or execution of Skill contents
